_meta.purpose: Neutral manifest for a new living document.

meta.title: Quartermaster
meta.subtitle: Deterministic catalog, compatibility, deployment, rollback, and advisory management for multi-harness agent artifacts.
meta.thesis: Quartermaster is the provenance-aware control plane for a source-linked skill library, metadata-backed views, explicit loadouts, compatibility checks, and reversible deployment; the current milestone is configured and verified but not cut over.
meta.audience: The operator and agents integrating Quartermaster into the Agentic Operating System.

modelReplies.prompt: When should Quartermaster perform its first harness deployment?
modelReplies.context: The source registry, catalog, loadout, rollback record, and 358-target Codex dry run are verified; no harness has been changed.

options.label: Recommended
options.text: Review the 29-operation Codex plan, then authorize Codex as the single reversible pilot harness.

options.label: Alternative
options.text: Refine the loadout into smaller task-specific sets before any harness cutover.

options.label: Custom
options.text: Choose another harness, loadout, or cutover condition.

modelReplies.prompt: How should Damage Control re-enter the managed loadout?
modelReplies.context: The copies remain unchanged and the package is intentionally excluded until their versions are reconciled.

options.label: Recommended
options.text: Wait, compare the competing copies, select or merge the canonical version with rationale, then add it to the loadout.

options.label: Alternative
options.text: Keep all copies cataloged as variants but deploy none.

reconciliation.readingPolicy: Read every in-scope Markdown and text file and every script in full; catalog boilerplate, generated, dependency, and byte-identical duplicate files with explicit exemptions.
